newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX seeks agency's help with AT&T.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX seeks agency's help with AT&T.

text.p: NYNEX Corp said Friday it has appealed to the New York Public Service Commission for assistance in reaching an interconnection agreement with AT&T Corp.
NYNEX said that in a letter to the agency, it said it was "deeply concerned" that an agreement was unlikely to be reached soon unless the commission stepped in.
Talks aimed at reaching an interconnection agreement with AT&T began last March. The parties filed for arbitration in August.
Although the commission issued an order in late November resolving outstanding issues, the companies have not been able to agree on contract language.
